value.rationale: The sum-of-all-distinct-derivatives Sobolev norm is a canonical endpoint norm in a recent isometry classification. Quantitative distortion by the full one-parameter rotation group is a natural invariant not furnished by a mere isometry classification. The exact profile exhibits isolated isometric angles, surprising off-diagonal sqrt(5) maxima, a diagonal cusp minimum at 2, and a sharp infinitesimal slope 4. Endpoint L1 non-inequality is needed for sharpness: plane-wave tests and Hilbertian tensor invariance cannot substitute for it. The result is a natural complete SO(2) norm classification, not an arbitrary slice.
